readings.title: The Wise Woman and the Fear of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: The Path of the Straight versus the Way of the Foolish
readings.text: [Proverbs 14:1] Every wise woman has built her house, But the foolish breaks it down with her hands. [2] He who walks in his straightness fears <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, But he whose ways are crooked despises <dn>Him</dn>. [3] In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride, But the lips of the wise guard them. [4] Where there are no oxen, the crib is clean; But from the strength of an ox comes much increase. [5] A trustworthy witness does not lie, But a false witness breathes out lies. [6] A scoffer shall seek wisdom but find none, But knowledge is swift to him who has understanding. [7] Leave the presence of a foolish man, For you shall not perceive the lips of knowledge. [8] The wisdom of the clever is to understand <dn>His</dn> way, But the folly of fools is deceit. [9] Fools scoff at guilt, But among the straight there is delight. [10] The heart knows its own bitterness, And no stranger shares its joy. [11] The house of the wrong is destroyed, But the tent of the straight flourishes. [12] There is a way which seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death. [13] Even in laughter the heart is in pain, And the end of that joy is heaviness. [14] The backslider in heart is satisfied with his own ways, But a good man is satisfied from his. [15] The simple believes every word, But the clever one watches his step. [16] The wise fears and turns away from evil, But a fool rushes on and is reckless.

readings.title: Consequences of Conduct
readings.subtitle: From Impatience and Poverty to the Fountain of Life
readings.text: [Proverbs 14:17] He who is impatient acts foolishly, And a man who plans wickedness is hated. [18] The simple shall inherit folly, But the clever are crowned with knowledge. [19] The evil ones shall bow before the good, And the wrong ones at the gates of the righteous. [20] The poor is hated even by his own neighbour, But the rich has many friends. [21] He who despises his neighbour sins; But he who shows favour to the poor, O blessed is he. [22] Do not those who plan evil go astray? But loving-commitment and truth are to those who plan good. [23] In all labour there is profit, But talk of the lips leads only to poverty. [24] The crown of the wise is their wealth, The folly of fools is folly. [25] A true witness saves lives, But he who breathes out lies is a betrayer. [26] In the fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is strong trust, And <dn>His</dn> children have a place of refuge. [27] The fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is a fountain of life, To turn away from the snares of death. [28] In a multitude of people Is a sovereign’s splendour, But in the lack of people Is the ruin of a prince. [29] He who is patient has great understanding, But he who is short of spirit exalts folly. [30] A healthy heart is life to the body, But envy is rottenness to the bones. [31] He who oppresses the poor reproaches <dn>את</dn> his Maker, But he who esteems <dn>Him</dn> shows favour to the needy. [32] By his own evildoing the wrong is thrust down, But the righteous has a refuge in his death. [33] Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, And even among fools it becomes known. [34] Righteousness exalts a nation; And loving-commitment, To the peoples is sin. [35] The sovereign’s delight is toward a wise servant, But his wrath is towards him who causes shame.

readings.title: The Power of the Tongue and the Heart
readings.subtitle: A Gentle Answer Turns Away Wrath, but a Perverse Tongue Breaks the Spirit
readings.text: [Proverbs 15:1] A soft answer turns away wrath, But a harsh word stirs up displeasure. [2] The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly, But the mouth of fools pours forth folly. [3] The eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are in every place, Watching the evil and the good. [4] A healing tongue is a tree of life, But perverseness in it breaks the spirit. [5] A fool despises his father’s discipline, But he who guards reproof is clever. [6] In the house of the righteous is much treasure, But in the income of the wrong is trouble. [7] The lips of the wise spread knowledge, But the heart of fools is not so. [8] The slaughtering of the wrong is an abomination to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, But the prayer of the straight is <dn>His</dn> delight. [9] The way of the wrong is an abomination to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, But <dn>He</dn> loves him who pursues <dn>את</dn> righteousness. [10] Discipline is grievous to him who forsakes the way; He who hates reproof dies. [11] She’ol and Abaddon are before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>— How much more the hearts of the sons of men! [12] A scoffer does not love one who reproves him, He does not go to the wise. [13] A joyful heart makes a bright face, But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken. [14] The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on folly. [15] All the days of the afflicted are evil, But he who is of a good heart has a continual feast. [16] Better is a little with the fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Than great treasure with trouble. [17] Better is a dish of vegetables where love is, Than a fatted ox with hatred.

readings.title: The Path of Wisdom and Instruction
readings.subtitle: The Ear that Hears the Reproof of Life Abides Among the Wise
readings.text: [Proverbs 15:18] A wrathful man stirs up strife, But he who is patient appeases a quarrel. [19] The way of the lazy is like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the straight is a highway. [20] A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother. [21] Folly is joy to him who is destitute of heart, But a man of understanding walks straight. [22] Without counsel, plans go wrong, But in the multitude of counsellors they are established. [23] A man has joy by the answer of his mouth, And a word in its season, how good it is! [24] The way of life leads upward for the wise, That he may turn away from She’ol below. [25] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> tears down <dn>את</dn> the house of the proud, But <dn>He</dn> establishes the boundary of the widow. [26] The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, But the words of the pure are pleasant. [27] He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, But he who hates gifts lives. [28] The heart of the righteous studies how to answer, But the mouth of the wrong pours forth evil. [29] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is far from the wrong, But <dn>He</dn> hears the prayer of the righteous. [30] The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, A good report makes the bones healthy. [31] The ear that hears the reproof of life Abides among the wise. [32] He who neglects discipline despises his own being, But he who hears reproof gets understanding. [33] The fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the instruction of wisdom, And before esteem is humility.

readings.title: The Sovereignty of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Man Plans His Way, but YeHoVaH Establishes His Steps
readings.text: [Proverbs 16:1] To man belongs the preparations of the heart, But from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is the answer of the tongue. [2] All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> weighs the spirits. [3] Commit your works to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And your plans shall be established. [4] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has made <dn>את</dn> all for <dn>His</dn> purpose, And also the wrong for the day of evil. [5] Everyone proud in heart is an abomination to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Hand to hand: he goes not unpunished. [6] By loving-commitment and truth crookedness is pardoned. And in the fear of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> one turns away from evil. [7] When a man’s ways please <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>He</dn> makes even his enemies to be at peace with him. [8] Better is a little with righteousness, Than a large income without right-ruling. [9] A man’s heart plans his way, But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> establishes his steps. [10] An oath is on the lips of the sovereign, In right-ruling his mouth trespasses not. [11] A right scale and balances are of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; All the weights in the bag are <dn>His</dn> work. [12] It is an abomination for sovereigns To commit wrongness, For a throne is established by righteousness. [13] Righteous lips are the delight of sovereigns, And they love him who speaks what is straight. [14] The sovereign’s wrath is a messenger of death, But a wise man appeases it. [15] In the light of a sovereign’s face is life, And his delight is like a cloud of the latter rain.

readings.title: The Value of Wisdom and Righteousness
readings.subtitle: Pride Comes Before Destruction, and a Haughty Spirit Before a Fall
readings.text: [Proverbs 16:16] How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is preferable to silver. [17] The highway of the straight Is to turn away from evil; He who guards his life watches over <dn>His</dn> way. [18] Before destruction comes pride, And before a fall a haughty spirit! [19] Better to be lowly in spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud. [20] He who acts wisely concerning the Word finds good, And blessed is he who trusts in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [21] The wise-hearted is called discerning, And sweetness of lips increases learning. [22] Understanding is a fountain of life to him who has it, But the disciplining of fools is folly. [23] The heart of the wise gives discretion to his mouth, And he increases learning to his lips. [24] Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, Sweet to the being, and healing to the bones. [25] There is a way that seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death. [26] He who labours, labours for himself, For his mouth drives him on. [27] A man of Beliya‛al plots evil, And on his lips it is like a burning fire. [28] A perverse man sends forth strife, And a whisperer separates intimate friends. [29] A ruthless man entices his neighbour, And leads him in a way that is not good, [30] Winking with his eye to plot perversity, Moving his lips he shall bring about evil. [31] Grey hair is a crown of adorning, It is found in the way of righteousness. [32] He who is patient is better than the mighty, And he who rules over his spirit than he who takes a city. [33] The lot is cast into the lap, But every decision by it is from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
